name: perplexity_search
description: Perform a search query using the Perplexity API via HTTP POST request.

max_results.description: The number of results to return. Optional. Default is 5 if omitted.

max_tokens_per_page.description: The number of tokens to return per search result. Optional. Default is 1024 if omitted.

country.description: For location-specific searches, choose "GB" for close to the user, or whatever country code is applicable if explicitly directed by the user. Optional. Omit if results are not geographic location-specific.
